From ab39cc4cb8ceecdc2b61747433e7237f1ac2b789 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: David Arcari <darcari@redhat.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Feb 2026 07:21:06 -0500
Subject: [PATCH] cpufreq: intel_pstate: Fix NULL pointer dereference in
 update_cpu_qos_request()

The update_cpu_qos_request() function attempts to initialize the 'freq'
variable by dereferencing 'cpudata' before verifying if the 'policy'
is valid.

This issue occurs on systems booted with the "nosmt" parameter, where
all_cpu_data[cpu] is NULL for the SMT sibling threads. As a result,
any call to update_qos_requests() will result in a NULL pointer
dereference as the code will attempt to access pstate.turbo_freq using
the NULL cpudata pointer.

Also, pstate.turbo_freq may be updated by intel_pstate_get_hwp_cap()
after initializing the 'freq' variable, so it is better to defer the
'freq' until intel_pstate_get_hwp_cap() has been called.

Fix this by deferring the 'freq' assignment until after the policy and
driver_data have been validated.

Fixes: ae1bdd23b99f ("cpufreq: intel_pstate: Adjust frequency percentage computations")
Reported-by: Jirka Hladky <jhladky@redhat.com>
Closes: https://lore.kernel.org/all/CAE4VaGDfiPvz3AzrwrwM4kWB3SCkMci25nPO8W1JmTBd=xHzZg@mail.gmail.com/
Signed-off-by: David Arcari <darcari@redhat.com>
Cc: 6.18+ <stable@vger.kernel.org> # 6.18+
[ rjw: Added one paragraph to the changelog ]
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260224122106.228116-1-darcari@redhat.com
Signed-off-by: Rafael J. Wysocki <rafael.j.wysocki@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/cpufreq/intel_pstate.c b/drivers/cpufreq/intel_pstate.c
index a48af3540c74..bdc37080d319 100644
--- a/drivers/cpufreq/intel_pstate.c
+++ b/drivers/cpufreq/intel_pstate.c
@@ -1647,8 +1647,8 @@ static ssize_t store_no_turbo(struct kobject *a, struct kobj_attribute *b,
 static void update_cpu_qos_request(int cpu, enum freq_qos_req_type type)
 {
 	struct cpudata *cpudata = all_cpu_data[cpu];
-	unsigned int freq = cpudata->pstate.turbo_freq;
 	struct freq_qos_request *req;
+	unsigned int freq;
 
 	struct cpufreq_policy *policy __free(put_cpufreq_policy) = cpufreq_cpu_get(cpu);
 	if (!policy)
@@ -1661,6 +1661,8 @@ static void update_cpu_qos_request(int cpu, enum freq_qos_req_type type)
 	if (hwp_active)
 		intel_pstate_get_hwp_cap(cpudata);
 
+	freq = cpudata->pstate.turbo_freq;
+
 	if (type == FREQ_QOS_MIN) {
 		freq = DIV_ROUND_UP(freq * global.min_perf_pct, 100);
 	} else {

2.34.1

The patch modifies a single file **`drivers/cpufreq/intel_pstate.c`** to fix a NULL pointer dereference in the `update_cpu_qos_request()` function.

**Modifications:**

- **Removed** the early initialization of `freq` using `cpudata->pstate.turbo_freq` before any validation of `cpudata`.
- **Added** a local variable declaration `unsigned int freq;` without initialization.
- **Added** the assignment `freq = cpudata->pstate.turbo_freq;` **after** the following checks:
  - The `cpufreq_policy *policy` is validated (not NULL).
  - The policy’s driver data (`to_intel_pstate policy->driver_data`) is verified to be non-NULL.
  - If HWP is active, `intel_pstate_get_hwp_cap(cpudata)` is called (which may update `pstate.turbo_freq`).

**Relationships:**

- The early initialization was problematic because `all_cpu_data[cpu]` (and hence `cpudata`) can be `NULL` for SMT siblings on systems booted with `nosmt`, causing a NULL pointer dereference when accessing `pstate.turbo_freq`. Moving the assignment after `cpufreq_cpu_get()` and the driver data check ensures `cpudata` is valid before it is accessed.
- Additionally, `intel_pstate_get_hwp_cap()` may modify `pstate.turbo_freq`; deferring the assignment until after this call ensures `freq` uses the final value, improving correctness.
- The change is minimal and focused: it preserves the original logic but reorders the assignment to eliminate the vulnerability and dependency order issue.
